body.summary: Shipped s5: the installed daemon was updated to e5e374b5 and restarted with no store migration and no re-index. Smoke 1 first failed on the step tool (it announced XL for an unindexed path), fixed as ISSUE-7c255f61, then passed; smoke 2 and 3 passed on a reindex of AFM. Results in S005/smoke.md.

feedback.author: subho@insors.io (decision, recorded by the controller)
feedback.comment: Story s5 BUILD approved with the code review's warn verdict (stakeholder decision 2026-10-14, after 3 daemon review rounds). Round 1 (0/3/16): cache hit vs miss rule, duplicated under-index rule and five real LOWs fixed in 96d4c105. Round 2 (0/5/8): cancellation wrapped as a failed model call (plus complete() retrying an abort and the retry helper rewriting it) and a cache hit skipping the not-indexed check fixed in e0edb0bb; the executePlan catch and two 'smoke not visible' MEDs judged not defects. Round 3 (0/3/11) accepted: MED driver.ts:373 (docs not refused at runShaper) is ISSUE-0c845762; MED handler.ts:123 (a 'repo-indexing' refusal for a FAILED last index is marked retryable) and MED ollama.ts:774 (Ollama request errors such as a 400 now read as an outage) are filed together as one bugfix. All LOWs accepted as they stand, and the plan's wording that a generic run under index is refused is accepted as superseded by the LLD's edge case (generic is not checked), which the code follows. Smoke results: S005/smoke.md.
